sources.title: FineWeb-Edu: Quality Educational Web Data
sources.snippet: FineWeb-Edu is a high-quality, large-scale educational web dataset comprising 1.3 trillion tokens from curated English texts. Its innovative filtering pipeline uses extraction, heuristic quality checks, and deduplication to enhance performance on reasoning and knowledge benchmarks.
